purpose: Read-only selected O1-O13 source capability inventory; no O-phase implementation or compatibility acceptance
revision_refresh: The earlier a60e427 review remains applicable: git diff a60e427..82ba94b -- core commands is empty. No product behavior was re-executed.

classification_contract.already_implemented: A current code path exists for the stated narrower group; execution, option conflict parity, platforms and publication are not re-certified.
classification_contract.defect: A concrete source/declaration inconsistency or selected-contract rejection/ignored input is visible. This is not newly executed GNU differential evidence.
classification_contract.missing_project_work: Selected parser/algorithm/output behavior is absent or explicitly rejected; no public-API blocker has been established for that algorithm.
classification_contract.documented_public_api_boundary: A precise existing ADR/support boundary applies to the stated conditional behavior. This review did not perform a fresh dependency API absence proof.

common_unverified: Frozen GNU option repeat/order/conflict/error precedence and alias forms were not executed.
No compatibility, backend-pair, published-consumer, performance or final API-gap acceptance follows from this inventory.
README/help/catalog/support describe current bounded profiles; an entry in the catalog can represent a registered rejection rather than support.
New work must preserve existing implementations listed in retain; absence of a selected extension does not justify rewriting its prerequisites.

oracle_questions.common: canonical/alias/cluster/=value, missing/invalid/zero/negative/overflow, -- operands, repeats/conflicts/order, empty/stdin/multifile/binary/no final delimiter, later error/prefix/effects
oracle_questions.O1: group/count separators; suppressed comm columns/totals; join case/header/auto duplicate keys; wc totals with failed operands
oracle_questions.O2: stable versus whole-line tie fallback, merge input ordering, same-input output opening, random-source hash/order/consumption/exhaustion
oracle_questions.O3: oracle ABI precision and rounding, single seq float conversion and -w conflicts, fmt margins/prefixes, printf hex/quote flags and error prefixes
oracle_questions.O4: absolute /N and relative +N trailing stops, repeat ordering and CR/backspace interactions
oracle_questions.O5: all six chunk forms and selected stdout, line-byte oversized records, suffix starts/exhaustion, filter $FILE/pipe/wait/cleanup, elide applicability
oracle_questions.O6: csplit integer format/%%/width/suppress/offset/repeat; multifile no added bytes; tac regex zero/overlap matching
oracle_questions.O7: od actual ABI float aliases/traditional offset/label conflicts; hexdump custom/color units and skip; cmp byte quoting; strings separator/encoding boundaries
oracle_questions.O8: xxd binary/EBCDIC/endian/group/case/autoskip mode conflicts; relative/end-relative/reverse address adjustments; output file safety
oracle_questions.O9: algorithm/length/tag/base64/raw/check conflicts, digest standard vectors and GNU record escaping/empty/malformed summaries
oracle_questions.O10: realpath lexical versus physical combinations; mktemp template/environment precedence; symbolic mkdir omitted-who umask; rm prompt/force ordering and input source
oracle_questions.O11: layout width after quoting; nine C-locale quoting styles and env/short-option precedence; explicit color rules
oracle_questions.O12: JSON/HTML escape and color conflicts; pattern/matchdirs/prune/filelimit/du/count/report order and ordinary-file size
oracle_questions.O13: env GNU split/escape/variable behavior; xargs delimiter combinations and independent confirmation channel; tail NUL origins/headers; tee pipe/file output-error classification

entries.finding: Neither option is parsed. Field output reuses input delimiter; byte/character selection emits contiguous selected bytes without an output delimiter.
Only one representative record is retained/emitted per adjacent group. No all-repeated/group parser or separator state exists.
Column prefixes are hardcoded TABs; merge has no total counters or total-output mode.
Ignore-case/header absent; -o accepts parsed explicit field lists, not auto.
Totals are hardwired to files.length()>1; no total policy argument.
No stable/merge/output options. Existing in-memory sorting and key comparisons are prerequisites, not these modes.

-R/--random-sort is recognized and explicitly rejected for lack of an audited deterministic seed contract. This is documented project work, not a proven missing public API; no random-source parser exists.
retain: explicit pre-input rejection until exact GNU random behavior is implemented

entries.finding: Output option is not implemented. Future existing-file identity/handle-truncate semantics must respect the documented shared filesystem boundary. This does not block implementing safe new output files or input spooling.
Manual parser supports equal-width and separator but no format option.
retain: negative increments and existing range checks

retain: fixed stop conversion and existing pending-space logic

Declared as a flag and digit array initializes to zero; arbitrary starting value absent.

options: all frozen-oracle float formats and aliases

Option absent; existing first/verbose/silent comparisons and offsets must be extended, not rewritten.
No separator option; current encoding/min-length/offset behavior remains reusable.
Requested selectors absent. Existing plain/reverse/include/cols/len/name paths exist.

options: nonnegative absolute -s forward discard on stdin/file
entries.finding: Reads/discards in bounded blocks without requiring seekability. Current accepted offset is bounded to signed32 range.
Parser reduces seek argument to an integer and rejects negative values; no distinct relative/end-relative state. Plus-prefixed integer acceptance is not established by this review.
Plain reverse writes a zero prefix from seek_opt before decoded bytes. Exact GNU mode/offset semantics remain unverified.

options: -s output address adjustment in addressed reverse
entries.finding: -s is accepted/parsed but addressed reverse calls reverse_dump_stream without using seek_opt. Ignored option is visible in source; final oracle adjustment semantics still need execution.
Second operand explicitly rejected; safe creation is project work.
Shared identity/handle-truncation boundary constrains future existing-target semantics. It must not block safe new output creation or justify inode-replacing rename.
cksum has only metadata options and POSIX CRC/length processing. Algorithm selector/length/output/check modes absent; existing public/shared digest code is reusable, not an API blocker.
retain: multiple file/stdin operand ordering and partial failures
public MD5/SHA1/SHA512 and existing SHA256 adapter

entries.finding: Shared checker explicitly supports only untagged records; no command parses --tag. SHA256 maintains a separate checker needing consistent extension.

Do not recreate these parsers/summary modes. Shared core escapes backslash/LF/CR; SHA256's separate encoder/decoder handles backslash/LF only. The CR discrepancy needs frozen-oracle review before a defect/repair claim.
Only -e/-z parsed; all paths delegate to fs.realpath. ADR explicitly says lexical -s implementable and separates it from physical missing-path links.

options: physical missing-component/link resolution beyond lexical profile
entries.finding: Full missing-path symlink semantics may require unavailable public readlink. This is not a boundary for the selected lexical modes; fresh API verification remains required.
Only directory flag exists. Default uses TMPDIR or /tmp plus tmp.XXXXXX and trailing-X templates; extension/env/template/quiet contracts not implemented.
Only octal numeric mode parser exists. Public mkdir/chmod application is already used; symbolic evaluation is project work, while omitted-who umask and platform effects need separate validation.
No interaction state or parser. Explicit rm prompting must use its own frozen input contract; do not assume xargs's independent-confirmation requirement or general terminal detection blocks it.

Current rendering is one raw name plus classification suffix per line; selected layout/quote/color options absent. Explicit color does not require isatty. Existing executable/type observations can be reused.

declaration_findings.finding: Usage advertises FILE... while implementation and README/support reject multiple inputs. Fix help as part of actual multifile implementation, not by inferring support from usage.
Existing docs/source cite missing seek API for a forward-only operation already expressible by public Reader discard.
Catalog random-sort entry represents a recognized explicit rejection; do not report it as implemented random sorting.
Catalog omits implemented max-lines/max-chars/max-procs/eof/show-limits. This is existing metadata inventory debt, not evidence those source options need implementation.
Shared checksum handles CR escapes, standalone SHA256 does not. Verify exact frozen GNU CR/CRLF contracts before deciding repair; backslash/LF escaping already exists in both.
